output.reason: [ev-5cbf04b8633d] gives only a one-line UI bug fix: the UI could not add an app that has both a name and a server destination. Whether an environment is affected depends on whether users actually try to create such apps through the UI, and no configuration, values key or manifest shows that. So an undecidable runtime-behavior-gap condition is the right exposure. It is not too broad and does not invent a predicate.
